known_limits: Login rate limiting is an in-process fixed ten-attempt-per-minute-per-peer guard; it is not a distributed or persisted limiter.
Trusted proxy forwarded host/scheme handling is peer allowlisted and only used for Origin same-origin evaluation; deployment still owns proxy/network configuration.
SSE uses durable polling and replay/redaction but does not yet provide a bounded subscriber queue/backpressure implementation or a single canonical handler wiring in App composition.
Traversal detection route records a pending API operation but does not execute/persist the full P12 detector profile; P14 restore/reauthorization surfaces have no invented frozen API routes.
Normal and force node deletion API paths enqueue decommission intents but do not fully expose operation progression or invoke the P14 Hub.ForceCloseNodeSession/lifecycle service from App composition.

Forward creation/PATCH now preserve and validate frozen optional fields, but rate/stat changes are persisted desired-state fields and are not wired to live Agent session counters/limiter lifecycle; disconnect_existing is accepted but not connected to live sessions.
Navigation create routes validate Idempotency-Key but do not yet persist/replay idempotency records.
Settings persistence is JSON-backed and ETag-checked, but private-site enforcement, full controller listen-address projection, and all deployment profile API routes are not complete.
Traffic ingest/rollups are durable store APIs; no Agent traffic wire message exists in the frozen protocol implementation, so live Agent ingest remains unwired.
The required combined focused race command exited 1 after a ten-minute timeout in pre-existing store TestR16Q2ProbeLookupCountsLookaheadDuplicateAsAmbiguous; targeted P15 race suites passed.
